description: Delete a sandbox: its files and any sign-in made inside it. Cloud: its recorded traces are deleted too unless keep_traces is true, which only paid plans honour (traces then stay until the plan's retention date). Local: its captured logs are moved to ~/.raytrace/archive unless delete_logs is true. This cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.

delete_logs.description: Local: delete the logs captured in the sandbox (its Claude Code sessions and recorded commands) instead of archiving them. Defaults to false.

id.description: A cloud sandbox's id (rtp-...), or a local sandbox's name, from list_sandboxes.

keep_traces.description: Cloud: keep the sandbox's recorded traces until the retention date (paid plans). Defaults to false.

upload_first.description: Local: upload the sandbox's evidences to RayTrace cloud before deleting it (needs a sign-in). Defaults to false.

name: destroy_sandbox
title: Destroy a sandbox
